lines.japanese: …………どこだ、ここ。
lines.english: ...Where am I?

lines.japanese: 吹き抜けの、やけにだだっ広い……ええと、オフィスビルの一階……に入ってるコーヒー屋か。
lines.english: An atrium. Ridiculously huge... Let's see. A coffee shop... on the ground floor of an office building?

lines.japanese: こんなとこに何の用だ、あいつ。つーか、今日はアレキサンダーじゃないのか。
lines.english: What the hell was he doing here? And wasn't he supposed to be at Alexander today?

lines.japanese: 俺は壁の洒落た時計を見た。２２時ちょっと前。
lines.english: I checked the stylish clock on the wall. Not quite ten.

lines.japanese: ほー、ここんとこ遅延続きだったあいつにしちゃ上出来だ。俺は首と肩をほぐし、十本の指が自在に動くことを確かめた。
lines.english: Huh. Pretty good for a guy whose handoffs had been running late lately. I loosened my neck and shoulders and made sure all ten fingers obeyed.

lines.japanese: ──よし、行こう。硬い椅子から立ちあがる。脇に置いてあったスポーツバッグを拾おうとしたとき、テーブルの上のコーヒーカップに気付いた。
lines.english: —Good. Let's go. I rose from the hard chair. Reaching for the sports bag beside me, I noticed the coffee cup on the table.

lines.japanese: カップには三口分ぐらいの茶色い液体が残っていた。その横に伝票と小銭が置いてある。それから、一冊の文庫本。
lines.english: Three sips or so of brown liquid remained. Beside the cup lay the check, some coins, and a paperback.

lines.japanese: 俺は本を手に取った。表紙は宮川書店の包装紙で覆われていた。一枚めくって中表紙を覗く。『ほほえみインサイド』。へんなタイトル。すぐに閉じてバッグに突っこんだ。
lines.english: I picked up the book. Miyagawa Books wrapping paper covered it. I turned one page and peeked at the title: *Smile Inside*. Weird title. I shut it at once and shoved it into the bag.

lines.japanese: テーブルの上のカップに目がいったが、口をつける気にもなれなかった。俺は伝票とその代金を掴んで店を出た。
lines.english: My eyes returned to the cup, but I didn’t feel like drinking from it. I took the check and the money left beside it and went out.

lines.japanese: 柳木原西口のオフィス街から、駅構内を経由して東口の繁華街へ向かう。
lines.english: From the office district at Yanagihara's west exit, I cut through the station toward the entertainment quarter on the east side.

lines.japanese: 見上げた吊り時計の長針が、１２と１のあいだに架かっていた。
lines.english: On the hanging clock overhead, the minute hand bridged twelve and one.

lines.japanese: 今夜もどこかでジェンベが鳴いている。
lines.english: Somewhere tonight, a djembe was crying again.

lines.japanese: その音が耳に忍びこんでくると、考えたくなくても昨晩の件が思いだされてしまう。
lines.english: The sound stole into my ears, and whether I wanted it or not, last night came back to me.

lines.japanese: 事後処理を香田に押しつけてしまったが、問題はなかっただろうか。
lines.english: I'd dumped the whole aftermath on Koda. Had things turned out all right?

lines.japanese: 現場へ向かうまでには、まだ幾分かの時間があった。
lines.english: I still had a little time before I needed to be at the job site.

lines.japanese: 俺はいつもの階段に腰を下ろしていた。
lines.english: I sat on my usual stairs.

lines.japanese: どこかで見たことのあるような人波が、誰ひとり俺に声をかけず通りすぎてゆく。
lines.english: A familiar-looking tide of people passed without a single person speaking to me.

lines.japanese: 今日はどれだけこの街に溶けこもうとしても、まったく馴染んでいかなかった。
lines.english: Today, however hard I tried to blend into this city, I couldn’t feel at home in it.

lines.japanese: 柳木原で腰を下ろして、これだけ尻が冷たいと感じたのは初めてだった。
lines.english: I’d never sat down anywhere in Yanagihara and felt this cold under my ass.

lines.japanese: 座布団持ってりゃよかった。
lines.english: Should've brought a cushion.

lines.japanese: 「場所変えるか……」
lines.english: “Maybe I should move...”

lines.japanese: 立ちあがろうとしたそのとき。
lines.english: Just as I was about to rise—

lines.japanese: 「あー、やっぱりここにいたー」
lines.english: “Oh! I knew you'd be here.”

lines.japanese: 香田だ。俺はやつの姿を目にして、自分でも意外なほど胸を撫でおろしていた。
lines.english: Koda. The sight of her relieved me far more than I expected.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、大丈夫なの」
lines.english: “Are you all right?”

lines.japanese: 幼馴染みがリアルに銃で撃たれるなんて、こいつぐらいの歳の女にはトラウマものの光景だっただろう。塞ぎこんでしまっても不思議はないはずだが──
lines.english: Seeing her childhood friend shot with a real gun must have been enough to scar a girl her age. It would have been perfectly natural if she'd shut herself away—

lines.japanese: 「うん？　ああ、カズ君？　思ったより元気だったよ」
lines.english: “Hm? Oh, Kazu? He was doing better than I expected.”

lines.japanese: ──カズ君じゃねえよ、おまえだよ。おまえは大丈夫なのかよ。
lines.english: —Not Kazu. You. Are *you* all right?

lines.japanese: まあ、わりと大丈夫みたいだ。つえー女。
lines.english: Well, she looked mostly fine. She was tough.

lines.japanese: 「悪かった、昨日は先に帰っちゃって。ちょっと俺、ケーサツはいろいろあんだよ」
lines.english: “Sorry I left you there yesterday. Me and the police... it's complicated.”

lines.japanese: 「それよりおまえ、出歩くの辛いなら無理すんなよ？」
lines.english: “More to the point, if being out is rough right now, don't force it.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　ああ……うん、平気。ひひっ」
lines.english: “What? Oh... Yeah, I'm fine. Hee hee.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なにがおかしいんだよ」
lines.english: “Huh? What’s funny?”

lines.japanese: 「だってさ？　きのう、隼人君こそケガしてたじゃん？　だからこっちが心配してたのに、大丈夫かーなんて先にいわれちゃって、なんかアハハだアハハー」
lines.english: “Because you were the one who got hurt yesterday, right? I was worried about you, and then you beat me to asking if *I* was okay. It's just—ha ha, you know? Ha ha!”

lines.japanese: 軽いな。
lines.english: She was taking it lightly.

lines.japanese: まあ、無事でなにより。
lines.english: Still, she was safe. That was what mattered.

lines.japanese: 「つーか、元気そうなのはいいけど、後始末どうだった」
lines.english: “Anyway, you look energetic enough. How'd the cleanup go?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、うん、たるかったー」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah. What a pain.”

lines.japanese: じっとり睨みながら言う。俺は小さくなった。
lines.english: She said it with a heavy, lingering glare. I shrank into myself.

lines.japanese: 「あのあとパトカー呼んだら事情聴取とか色々あってー。超めんどくさいの。今日もいま行ってきたところだし、もホント勘弁だよ」
lines.english: “After that I called the police, and there were interviews and a million other things. Such a hassle. I only just got back from doing more today. Seriously, spare me.”

lines.japanese: 俺はどんどん小さくなった。
lines.english: I shrank smaller still.

lines.japanese: 「も、森里はどう」
lines.english: “H-how is Morisato?”

lines.japanese: 俺は話題を変えた。
lines.english: I changed the subject.

lines.japanese: 「安心しー？　後遺症とかそんなのはないって。本人いたってフツーに喋ってるし、二週間ぐらいで退院できるって先生いってたしー」
lines.english: “Relax, okay? No lasting damage or anything. He's talking perfectly normally, and the doctor says he can leave the hospital in about two weeks.”

lines.japanese: 「でもカズ君のガッコ、これから期末らしくて。そこはちょっと苦労しそうだって」
lines.english: “But Kazu's school has finals coming up. Apparently that's going to be the hard part.”

lines.japanese: 「つうかさ、なんでおまえら、あんなとこ来たんだよ。怪我すンの分かってて来たようなもんじゃん」
lines.english: “Seriously, why did you come to a place like that? You practically showed up knowing you'd get hurt.”

lines.japanese: 「えー！　なんでって！　だって隼人君、私ほったらかして、とつぜん走りだしちゃったンじゃん。あんなンされたら誰だって心配になるよ」
lines.english: “What do you mean, why? You ditched me and suddenly took off running. Anybody would worry after that.”

lines.japanese: ああ、そうだったな……。
lines.english: Oh. That was right...

lines.japanese: 俺は最初ヤナポリ広場でこいつと他愛もない話をしてたんだ。そうしたら偶然小鳩の危険を知って……ガルーダとかいう変なのが出てきて……
lines.english: Right. At first I'd been talking with her about nothing in Yanapoli Plaza. Then by pure chance I learned Kobato was in danger... and that freak calling himself Garuda appeared...

lines.japanese: そうだ、ガルーダ！　あいつはどうなったんだ。およそまともな奴じゃなかった。あのときは爺さんのまじないで追いかえしたけど、あんな爆弾野郎が俺たちの中に潜んでいたなんて──
lines.english: Garuda. Right! What had happened to him? He was nowhere near sane. The old man’s charm had driven him back then, but a walking time bomb like that had been hiding inside us—

lines.japanese: 「そんで、私ひとり残されてポカーンってしてたら、カズ君から電話かかってきて。ちょうどあのサイト見たらしくて、成田が心配だーって言ってて」
lines.english: “So I'm standing there alone, totally blank, and then Kazu calls. He'd just seen the site, apparently. Said he was worried about Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「カズ君が隼人君の心配するなんてレアじゃん？　私、やだウソよっぽど危険なんだとか思って」
lines.english: “Kazu worrying about you is rare, right? I thought, no way—this must be seriously dangerous.”

lines.japanese: 「あんな、危ないなら尚更だっての。危ないと思ったら尚更来んなよ、冒険家かおまえは」
lines.english: If you thought it was dangerous, that's even more reason not to come! What are you, some kinda explorer?

lines.japanese: 「え？　あれ？　何これ！　もしか隼人君、私のこと心配してんの！」
lines.english: “What? Wait, what's this? Hayato, were you worried about me?”

lines.japanese: いや、するだろさすがに。俺はべつに鬼じゃねえ。
lines.english: Of course I was. I wasn’t heartless.

lines.japanese: 「他には。あのチューリップ帽のでかいのとか、どうなったか分かる」
lines.english: “Anything else? Know what happened to that big guy in the bucket hat?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、当然お巡りさんは探してるんだろうけど……それ以上に、ＹＦＢのみんながカズ君のカタキーとか言いだして。もー大騒ぎ」
lines.english: “Well, naturally the police are looking... But on top of that, everybody in YFB started yelling about avenging Kazu. It's a whole huge mess.”

lines.japanese: 「うえ、関わりたくねえな」
lines.english: “Ugh. I want nothing to do with that.”

lines.japanese: もちろん関わらないけど。
lines.english: Not that I would, obviously.

lines.japanese: 「他には」
lines.english: “Anything else?”

lines.japanese: 「そーんな沢山のこと知らんしー。私べつにカケルさんトコとも佐久間君トコとも深いつながりないし。カズ君とか隼人君とかいなきゃ、そんな情報なんて大して入ってくるわけないじゃん」
lines.english: “I don’t know that much. I’m not exactly close to Kakeru’s people or Sakuma’s. If it weren’t for Kazu and you, I’d barely hear about any of this stuff.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょー、あたかも俺が関係者みたいな言い方すんのやめてくんない。俺は永世中立の一般人だから」
lines.english: “Whoa, whoa. Could you stop phrasing that like I'm involved? I'm a permanently neutral civilian.”

lines.japanese: 「だよねえ。うちら一般人チーム、成田工務店の若社長と美人秘書だもんねえ」
lines.english: “Right. We're Team Civilian—the young president of Narita Construction and his beautiful secretary.”

lines.japanese: 「おーおー、ちょ待てよ、いつの間に従業員数増えたんだよ成田工務店。社長初耳なんだけど」
lines.english: “Whoa, hang on. When did Narita Construction add an employee? News to the president.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ成田コーダインに社名変更しよっか」
lines.english: “Then let’s rename it Narita Kodine.”

lines.japanese: 「上手くねえよ。語呂だけじゃねーか。何の店か分からなくなってるっつうの。もういい、おまえ帰れ」
lines.english: “That’s not clever. You only like how it sounds. Now nobody can even tell what the company does. Enough. Go home.”

lines.japanese: 「なぁーん、もぉー！　そんな酷いこと言ぅーなしー」
lines.english: “Nooo! Come on! Don't say something so mean.”

lines.japanese: ああ、またこの流れか……何度目だよ……。
lines.english: Ah, this again... How many times had we done this now...?

lines.japanese: まあ、とりあえず香田には謝ったし、もう心残りもねえだろ。
lines.english: Well, I’d apologized to Koda. No unfinished business, then.

lines.japanese: 「悪り、もう行くわ」
lines.english: “Sorry. Gotta go.”

lines.japanese: スポーツバッグを掴んで、凍える階段から尻を上げる。気がつけば、地面の冷たさを忘れていた。
lines.english: I grabbed the sports bag and hauled myself off the freezing stairs. By then, I'd forgotten how cold the ground was.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、お仕事行くの？」
lines.english: “Oh, are you going to work?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、労働は国民の義務だからな」
lines.english: “Labor is the duty of every citizen.”

lines.japanese: 「ついてっていい？」
lines.english: “Can I come?”

lines.japanese: 「いいわけねえだろ」
lines.english: “Of course not.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ勝手に尾けちゃおうかなー」
lines.english: “Then maybe I’ll just follow you anyway.”

lines.japanese: 亜衣は口から突きだしたキャンディの棒を、ぴこぴこ上下に動かしていた。おい、まさか本気じゃねえだろうな。いちおう念を押しておこうと思いたったとき──
lines.english: Ai bobbed the lollipop stick protruding from her mouth. Was she actually serious? Just as I decided to make absolutely sure—

lines.japanese: 「イェア、いたいた！　成田君見っけー！」
lines.english: “Yeah, there he is! Found you, Narita!”

lines.japanese: ──背後からげんなりする声が響いた。
lines.english: —a voice that made my heart sink rang out behind me.

lines.japanese: 「こんなところに隠れてるなんて、どこ探してもいないはずだぜ。楽しんでるかい、粋がってるかい、ここからあんたの新世界、Ｅｈ？」
lines.english: “Hiding in a place like this? No wonder we couldn’t find you. Having fun? Acting tough? Your new world starts here—eh?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと待て……どいつもこいつも、なんで俺を探してるんだよ」
lines.english: “Wait... Why is every last one of you looking for me?”

lines.japanese: なあ、俺はそんな誰かに必要とされるような人間か？　違うだろ？
lines.english: Was I really the sort of person anybody needed? Of course not.

lines.japanese: これまで誰とも繋がりを持たずに生きてきたんだ。頼むよ、ほっといてくれ。
lines.english: I'd gone my whole life without forming ties to anyone. Please. Just leave me alone.

lines.japanese: だがやつらは、俺を三方向からがっちり取りかこんだ。
lines.english: But they boxed me in tight from three directions.

lines.japanese: 「マーニン！　いや～、実はうちの皇帝が成田っち探しててさ～、見つけたら絶対連れてくるように言われてンのよね～」
lines.english: “Mornin'! See, our Emperor's looking for you, Narita. Told us if we found you, we absolutely had to bring you in.”

lines.japanese: 「鳳？　なんでだよ。こっちはあいつに用なんかねえよ。ちょっ……待てよ、はなせよ」
lines.english: “Otori? Why? I don’t want anything from him. Hey... Wait. Let go.”

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃははは、俺たちの仲に遠慮なんて言葉はねえだろうが、ま、ちょっとの時間だ。付きあってくれよ成田君」
lines.english: “Gah ha ha! Come on, we're friends—no need to be shy. It'll only take a minute. Humor us, Narita.”

lines.japanese: ハゲとドレッドに両側からがっちりと肩を組まれた。声や表情こそいつものバカ陽気な調子だが、俺を拘束する腕力は意外と威圧的だった。
lines.english: Baldy and Dreads each locked an arm tight around one of my shoulders. Their voices and faces were as cheerfully idiotic as ever, but the strength restraining me was surprisingly menacing.

lines.japanese: いまの状態でこいつら三人相手じゃ、抵抗しても無駄か。
lines.english: In this condition, resisting all three would be pointless.

lines.japanese: 仮に今日逃げたとしても、あの鳳のことだ、毎日でも毎時間でも拉致りに来かねない。
lines.english: Even if I escaped today, knowing Otori, he might come abduct me every day, every hour.

lines.japanese: 俺は観念した。なんにせよとにかく実際やつに会って話をつけよう。
lines.english: I gave in. Whatever this was about, I might as well meet him and settle it directly.

lines.japanese: 「……どこ行きゃいいんだよ」
lines.english: “...Where do I have to go?”

lines.japanese: 俺は少し腕に力を込めて、両肩に載っかった腕を振りはらった。ヒュウ♪　ハゲの口笛が耳障り。
lines.english: I put a little strength into my arms and shook off those draped across my shoulders. Baldy gave a whistle that grated on my ears.

lines.japanese: 「ヘテロっス。翔さんが話あるッつって」
lines.english: “Hetero. Kakeru says he wants to talk.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだそりゃ」
lines.english: “About what?”

lines.japanese: だがそれについて連中は答えなかった。あいつのことだ、実際に内容までは話してないんだろう。兵隊は任務さえこなせばそれでいい。
lines.english: But they gave no answer. Knowing him, he probably hadn't told them the subject. Soldiers only needed enough information to complete the mission.

lines.japanese: 俺はハアと分かりやすいた溜息をついた。
lines.english: I let out an exaggerated sigh.

lines.japanese: 「わかったよ、行きゃいんだろ。おーコラ、だったらこっちも全部すっきりさせてやろうじゃねえか。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Fine. You want me to go, I'll go. All right, then. Let's clear every last thing up. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 俺を前後に挟んでハゲたちが歩きだす。この先のコインパーキングに、いつもの白ワゴンが停めてあるんだろう。俺が黙ってやつらに従おうとしたところで――
lines.english: Baldy and the others started walking with me boxed in, one in front and one behind. Their usual white van was probably in the coin lot up ahead. Just as I was about to follow without a word—

lines.japanese: 「え？　隼人君、行っちゃうの？」
lines.english: “What? Hayato, you’re leaving?”

lines.japanese: 香田が慌てて追いかけてきた。
lines.english: Koda hurried after us.

lines.japanese: 「ヘテロなら私もついてっていい？」
lines.english: “If you’re going to Hetero, can I come?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、来んな」
lines.english: “No. Stay here.”

lines.japanese: 「えー」
lines.english: “Aww.”

lines.japanese: 香田はなにか反論しかけたが、俺が目に力を込めると一瞬言葉を詰まらせた。
lines.english: Koda began to object, but when I hardened my stare, the words caught in her throat.

lines.japanese: 「な、なぁーん、もぉー！　そんな怒んなよう」
lines.english: “N-nooo! Come on, don't get mad at me.”

lines.japanese: 笑いで空気を変えようと俺を叩く。いつもに増してその力は弱い。
lines.english: She gave me a playful smack, trying to laugh off the tension. It was weaker than usual.

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿、そんなんじゃねえよ」
lines.english: “Idiot. That's not what this is.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、亜衣ぽんまた馬鹿ってゆわれたー。ははーん、いいもーん」
lines.english: “Ah ha ha! Poor little Ai got called an idiot again. Whatever. I don't caaare.”

lines.japanese: なにが嬉しいのかにこにこしてる。こいつを見ていると、いい加減呆れも笑いに変わっていく気がした。
lines.english: She stood there grinning over God knew what. Looking at her, I could feel my exasperation giving way to laughter.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんな。気を付けて帰れよ」
lines.english: “Sorry. Be careful going home.”

lines.japanese: 俺は香田を置いて前へ進んだ。
lines.english: I left Koda behind and went on.

lines.japanese: 鳳翔。俺に何の用だろう。胸騒ぎがした。
lines.english: Kakeru Otori. What did he want with me? Unease stirred in my chest.
